AuthorAssociation.description:
How the author of a thread or comment relates to its repository:

- `owner` owns the repository.
- `member` belongs to the organisation that owns it.
- `collaborator` was invited to collaborate on it.
- `contributor` has committed to it before.
- `first_time_contributor` has not committed to it before.
- `first_timer` has not committed to any repository on the forge before.
- `none` has none of these, or is a placeholder for an unclaimed account.
- `unknown` is an association with no normalised value; `authorAssociationRaw` names it.

events.description: Normalised kinds the subscription covers, derived from `nativeEvents`.

nativeEvents.description: Forge-native event names exactly as the forge stores them.

contentType.description: `'json'` or `'form'` where the forge offers a choice.

secret.description: Never returned: no forge reads a webhook secret back.

Webhook.description: A registered webhook. The secret is never readable, so it is never returned.

event.description: Forge-native event name of the delivery.

status.description: The HTTP status that the receiver answered with.

ok.description: `true` when the forge considered the delivery successful.

duration.description: Round trip in milliseconds, where the forge reports it.

instance.description: The host of the instance, such as `github.com` or `git.example.com`.

guid.description: Delivery guid, where the forge needs it to redeliver.

WebhookDeliveryRef.description: Reference to one delivery of a webhook.

instance.description: The host of the instance, such as `github.com` or `git.example.com`.

target.description: The repository or namespace that the hook is registered on.

WebhookRef.description: Reference to a registered webhook. `target` is the repository, or a namespace ref (`kind: 'namespace'`, empty `name`) for an organisation or workspace hook.
